caption:
A 40 page PDF? Do not ask AI to just summarise it.

Ask for structure, with page numbers so you can check:

Give the main point in one line, then 5 key facts with page numbers, then 3 questions I should ask about it.

Open the pages it cites before you quote anything. Send this to the friend with a reading assignment.
